508:t_2:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「They had simmering resentment toward $$フル・フロンタル$$'s methods. I merely steered them.」

508:t_2:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll prepare to receive them as quickly as possible too.」

508:t_2:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I understand. I'll contact Captain $$ジンネマン$$ aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

508:t_2:14.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Incidentally, the double of $$ミネバ・ラオ・ザビ$$ is among them.」

508:t_2:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The girl we saw aboard the $$グワダン$$ during the $$多元戦争$$...」

508:t_2:17.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So now we have two $$ミネバ・ザビ$$s with us.」

508:t_2:18.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Depending on how we use this, we may be able to undermine $$フロンタル$$'s declaration of succession to Earth's humanity.」

508:t_2:19.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I understand. We'll consider it while respecting her human rights.」

508:t_2:20.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Thank you for your consideration.」

508:t_2:21.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Normally, I'd ask you to lead your own forces, but I expect you wouldn't be satisfied with that.」

508:t_2:22.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I too have abandoned $$ジオン$$... From here on, I'll accompany this unit as an individual warrior.」

508:t_2:23.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'm confident I'll be more useful than $$シャア$$, at least.」

508:t_2:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I understand. Protect the unit until he returns.」

508:t_2:25.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Is she serious...? This is going to make things difficult.」

508:t_2:26.en:
$$シン$$
「Maybe we should flatter her a bit and get her to stay in the rear.」

508:t_2:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Why not act like veterans and explain how things work in $c?」

508:t_2:29.en:
$n
「No, first I'll ask her to fight me in a simulation. I've got a good training partner now.」

508:t_2:31.en:
$$シン$$
「That's not it, $$セツコ$$! $n is just crazy!」

508:t_2:32.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Oh... So training against me is apparently a very peculiar thing to do.」

508:t_2:34.en:
$$シン$$
「B-$$バナージ$$! You show $$ハマーン$$ around the unit!」

508:t_2:35.en:
$$バナージ$$
「H-huh!? You want me to do it!?」

508:t_2:36.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You looked after $$ミネバ$$. I must thank you for that too.」

508:t_2:37.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Oh, no... Please... Don't trouble yourself...!」

508:t_2:38.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You're pathetic, $$バナージ$$. Even you, who never shrink from anything, seem to be afraid of Her Excellency $$ハマーン$$.」

508:t_2:39.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's sad. It seems I won't be accepted here.」

508:t_2:41.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$n! You're good at dealing with older women, right!? I'm leaving this to you!」

508:t_2:42.en:
$n
「Huh...! Now you're dumping it on me!?」

508:t_2:43.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I hear you wish to fight me in a simulation. If that is what you want, I'll oblige.」

508:t_2:45.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Please go easy on them, $$ハマーン$$. Our youngsters seem to get shy once they leave their machines.」

508:t_2:46.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So it seems. They give quite a different impression from when I meet them on the battlefield.」

508:t_2:47.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「If I may say so, the same is true of you, Your Excellency.」

508:t_2:48.en:
$$クェス$$
「Since you've finally left $$ジオン$$, show us a side other than the Iron Lady, $$ハマーン$$.」

508:t_2:49.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're right. I'll make an effort.」

508:t_2:50.en:
$$ハマーン$$
(I'll be waiting for the day you return to $c, $$シャア$$.)

508:t_2:51.en:
$$ハマーン$$
(When you return, I'll settle the ties between us...)

508:t_10:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「That was amazing, $$アムロ$$. $$ハマーン$$ really took the bait when you provoked her!」

508:t_10:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I understood a little of how $$ハマーン$$ feels about pursuing him... I suppose that came out in my words.」

508:t_10:6.en:
$$クェス$$
「I know exactly what you mean! That's why $$ハマーン$$ reacted to what I said too!」

508:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right, $$クェス$$. Your fierce trash talk produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s from $$ハマーン$$.」

508:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

508:t_10:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's $$ハマーン$$ for you. She looks calm, but she holds powerful emotions deep in her heart.」

508:t_10:10.en:
$$クェス$$
「Hey, $$ＡＧ$$... If you talked to $$ハマーン$$ the way you usually do, wouldn't you keep producing $$Ｚチップ$$s?」

508:t_10:11.en:
$$クェス$$
「I'm sure $$ハマーン$$ would hurl tons of insults at you! 'Philistine,' 'scum,' 'insolent fool,' 'low-life'!」

508:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-all right...! Since we have the chance, shall I try it!?」
